response.text: The checkout pod stays Pending because the memory-holder container requests 256Gi, more than any node offers. The newest Sandbox commit raised the request.

structured.diagnosis: The checkout pod cannot be scheduled because the memory-holder container requests 256Gi of memory, which no node can satisfy. The newest Sandbox commit raised the request far above the known-good 64Mi that the container needs.

findings.summary: The checkout pod reports PodScheduled=False with reason Unschedulable because no node has 256Gi of allocatable memory.
The newest Sandbox commit raised the memory-holder memory request and limit to 256Gi.
